questions.stem:
Tourist: How do I get to the old town?

Local: ---

Which response is helpful?
options: Take the number 5 bus from here—it stops right in the old town.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: "The museum is closed for renovations." What should a visitor do?
options: Check opening times or visit another day; the museum is temporarily closed for updates.
questions.explanation: Renovations mean temporary closure; plan accordingly.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: Review: "Touristy but worth a visit." What does 'touristy' suggest?
options: Popular with tourists; may be crowded or commercial.
questions.explanation: Touristy means very popular with visitors, often commercial.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem:
Front desk: How many nights will you be staying?

Diner: ---

Which response is appropriate?
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: "The exchange rate isn't great at the moment." What might a traveller infer?
options: Their currency may buy less; they might get fewer units of local currency.
questions.explanation: Bad exchange rate means less local currency per unit.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: Sign: "Guided tours run every two hours on the hour." When do tours start?
questions.explanation: On the hour means at :00 each hour.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: Travel blog: "Skip the main square at noon—it's packed." What is the advice?
options: Avoid the main square at noon due to crowds.
questions.explanation: Packed means crowded; skip means avoid.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem:
Passenger: Is this seat taken?

Stranger: ---

Which response allows the passenger to sit?
questions.explanation: Stranger indicates the seat is available.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: "We got a last-minute deal on flights." What does this suggest?
options: They found a cheap offer booked shortly before travel.
questions.explanation: Last-minute deal means a late, discounted offer.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem:
Tour guide: Please don't touch the exhibits.

Why might this rule exist?
options: To protect the exhibits from damage.
questions.explanation: Touching can damage or degrade artefacts.
questions.subject: ing
